title: Fugue in B minor

captions.text: ☞ Dux: the subject in the alto, sighing pairs through all twelve notes.
☞ The answer in the tenor; above it, the alto's countersubject.
☞ The bass enters with the subject, on F♯.
☞ The soprano enters last, on B.
☞ The last entry, in the bass.

listenFor: 4 voices; a slow chromatic subject that uses all twelve notes
